title: Read the Usage Token index's selections and refreshes in mounted cases

intentCoverage.report:
## Dough Intent Coverage — `SEED-413#mount-usage-token-index-reading`

- **Verdict:** **Caught** (bounded to the exercised multi-tool model-reset path in `dashboard/frontend-tests/configuration/system-settings-usage-tool.spec.ts:24–96`, where hiding the last tool offering the selected model triggers a broadened `model: null` re-read whose returned task is then selected on the chart).
- **Next proof action:** None required for the exercised path. Note that `usage.showsCohort({ ..., Model: "All models", ... })` (`system-settings-usage-tool.spec.ts:79`) did not fail on its own because HTML `<select>` falls back to its first `<option>` (`"All models"`) once the unoffered `<option value="gpt-6-astra">` disappears; the fault was caught by the downstream chart task interaction `usage.selectPoint("Nov 1 · Claude Code · 2,000", "pointer")` (`system-settings-usage-tool.spec.ts:85`, failing inside `selectPoint` at `dashboard/frontend-tests/configuration/system-settings-usage-page.ts:179`). Keep that post-reset cohort-data observation in place if the spec is edited later.
- **Prior disposition / planned work:** No already-planned repair or prior disposition targets `offeredSelection` or `system-settings-usage-tool.spec.ts`; `SEED-413#renovate-later-dashboard-frontend-unit-test-families` carries only the 20 deferred Usage chart cases (`-average`, `-compare`, `-legend`, `-overflow`, `-spacing`). This probe introduces no new repair decision.

### Scope, Promise, and Fault

- **Story and revision:** `SEED-413#mount-usage-token-index-reading` (`.planning/seeds/SEED-413-renovate-dashboard-unit-tests.md#mount-usage-token-index-reading`, `.planning/slice-plans/740-mount-usage-token-index-reading/PLAN.md` Slice 3, and `.planning/slice-plans/740-mount-usage-token-index-reading/source-review.md` commitment 9) at revision `f59978c44d654e543b5033bb35318badb76a3084` (implementation tip `0eb69614cdbf621ddd47b227774c84470941fd2b`).
- **Validated promise:** Adding Claude Code alongside Codex keeps a Codex-only model (`GPT-6 Astra`) and offers both tools' models once; hiding Codex when remaining selected tool Claude Code does not offer that model resets `selection.model` to `null` (`All models`), preserves `workflow` (`Refinement`) and shared `effort` (`high`), and re-reads Claude Code under the broadened cohort so its matching task (`2,000`) is shown. Caller-suggested promise, fault target, and focused command held against the story and revision without consequential change.
- **Fault location and change:** `dashboard/src/usageComparison.ts:80–82` in `offeredSelection` — replaced `const model = models.some(({ id }) => id === selection.model) ? selection.model : null;` with `const model = selection.model;`, leaving `selection.model` unreset when no remaining selected tool offers it while keeping all test fixtures and assertions intact.
- **Fixture and maintained check examined:** Inline `UsageSource` in `dashboard/frontend-tests/configuration/system-settings-usage-tool.spec.ts:29–49` built with `makeMe.aTokenIndexAnswer` (`Distribution/tests/support/pageMakeMe.mjs`) and mounted via `mountUsage` (`dashboard/frontend-tests/configuration/system-settings-usage-page.ts:26–29`), where Claude Code offers `[opus]` and returns `[2_000]` only when `[null, opus.id].includes(cohort.model)` (`[]` otherwise). Focused command: `caffeinate -s -i env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES npm run --silent test:dashboard:frontend -- dashboard/frontend-tests/configuration/system-settings-usage-tool.spec.ts --workers=2` (2 cases in `system-settings-usage-tool.spec.ts`).

### Run, Wrong-Behavior, and Restoration Evidence

1. **Isolated scratch setup and baseline:** Created detached worktree `/tmp/dough-ic-740-69541` at `f59978c44d654e543b5033bb35318badb76a3084` (`npm ci --no-audit --no-fund`; pre-probe `git status --porcelain=v1` empty; active checkout `/Users/terryyin/git/open-dough/.worktrees/read-the-usage-token-index-s-selections-and-refr` left strictly untouched). Baseline run passed: `1 passed (1)` file, `2 passed (2)` tests (`670 ms` for line 24, `1,305 ms` for line 98; Vitest `Duration 3.41s`).
2. **Faulted run, reach, and wrong-behavior witness:** Applied the 1-statement `offeredSelection` fault under an `EXIT`/`INT`/`TERM` `git checkout` restore trap (`git status --porcelain=v1` showed only `M dashboard/src/usageComparison.ts`). Rerunning the identical command exited `1` (`1 failed | 1 passed (2)`, Vitest `Duration 17.39s`; sibling line-98 case passed in `1,175 ms`, target line-24 case failed in `15,191 ms`).
   - **Reach and independent wrong-behavior observation:** Vitest's step trace and failure screenshot (`adding-Claude-Code-keeps-a-Codex-only-model--offering-both-tools--models-once--hiding-Codex-then-resets-that-model-and-keeps-the-workflow-and-a-shared-effort.png`) showed execution completed selecting `Refinement` / `GPT-6 Astra` / `high`, showing `Claude Code` (`+126 ms`), hiding `Codex` (`+205 ms`), and rendering Claude Code's settled trend (`Claude test rate card` visible at `+382 ms`). Because `offeredSelection` returned `selection` unchanged (`kept === selection`), `useUsageAnswers` (`dashboard/src/useUsageAnswers.ts:80–85`) skipped `onReset`, never re-read Claude Code with `model: null`, and committed the empty `model: "gpt-6-astra"` answer: the failure screenshot showed `Codex` unchecked, `Claude Code` checked, `Launch workflow` `Refinement`, `Effort` `high`, `Model` visually defaulted to `All models`, and the trend stuck on `0 tasks · Last 30 days` / `No finished task matches in the last 30 days.`
   - **Catching assertion/helper:** `usage.showsCohort` (`line 79`) and `usage.offers` (`line 84`) passed because `<select>`'s DOM `selectedOptions[0]` fell back to `<option value="">All models</option>`, and `usage.selectPoint("Nov 1 · Claude Code · 2,000", "pointer")` (`dashboard/frontend-tests/configuration/system-settings-usage-tool.spec.ts:85` → `dashboard/frontend-tests/configuration/system-settings-usage-page.ts:179`, `await userEvent.click(target)`) caught the missing reset re-read with `TimeoutError: locator.click: Timeout 14518ms exceeded` waiting for button `'Nov 1 · Claude Code · 2,000'`.
3. **Restoration and scratch cleanup:** Restored `dashboard/src/usageComparison.ts` and verified `/tmp/dough-ic-740-69541` at `f59978c44d654e543b5033bb35318badb76a3084` had empty `git status --porcelain=v1` and empty `git diff` matching pre-probe state. Restored rerun passed: `1 passed (1)` file, `2 passed (2)` tests (`412 ms` for line 24, `764 ms` for line 98; Vitest `Duration 1.92s`). Removed `/tmp/dough-ic-740-69541` via `git worktree remove --force` (`SCRATCH_REMOVED=yes`) and verified `/Users/terryyin/git/open-dough/.worktrees/read-the-usage-token-index-s-selections-and-refr` remained clean at `f59978c44d654e543b5033bb35318badb76a3084`.
